title: Daisy Duck
blurb: Donald Duck's girlfriend, first drawn as an unnamed love interest before being formally named and designed for her own Disney short.
facts: She is often seen wearing a hair bow, blouse and heeled shoes.
The girlfriend of Donald Duck, Daisy was introduced in the short film Mr.
Duck Steps Out (1940) and was incorporated into Donald's comic stories several months later.
appearances: Mr. Duck Steps Out (1940, as Daisy)
